method: Average YouTube view count across each campaign's most recent 15 videos (or fewer, on a shorter playlist — campaigns under 3 videos are excluded as too thin to rank fairly). Average, not total, so a long-running campaign is not ranked above a shorter one purely for having more episodes. Recent videos only, not lifetime history, as the closer available proxy for current audience. Limited to campaigns with a YouTube playlist link — a campaign missing from this list may simply have no playlist recorded yet, not low viewership.
